description: Membership on a transitive set collapses to itself.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.transitive_fixed.{u} (T : ZFSet.{u}) (hT : T.IsTransitive)
  (h : WellFounded fun a b => ↑a ∈ ↑b) :
  (∀ (a : ↥T), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h a = ↑a) ∧
    ZFSet.range (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h) = T
